subject: Tiered usage smoothing + deferred billing arrangement discussion
messages:
From: Ava Nguyen <ava.nguyen@heliosai.com>
To: chloe.martin@redwood.ai
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@heliosai.com>, Procurement <procure@heliosai.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mid-quarter uplift + smoothing / deferred billing?

Chloe —

Quick summary: usage across our NLP inference pipeline spiked in August (attached). We expect sustained higher volume for the next 6–10 weeks while we finish a model rollout. Can you share options for: 1) a short-term uplift (additional capacity) that can be billed on a deferred cadence (invoice at quarter end), and 2) any smoothing credit if we commit to an elevated quarterly bucket vs ad-hoc top-ups?

Procurement is asking about how proration and co-terming would work if we add capacity mid-contract — we currently co-term on Feb 28 each year. We also need the amendment to support a 60-day invoice term if possible.

Attached: helios_usage_report_aug2026.csv

Thanks,
Ava Nguyen
Head of Platform, HeliosAI
ava.nguyen@heliosai.com
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Nguyen <ava.nguyen@heliosai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 08 Sep 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mid-quarter uplift + smoothing / deferred billing?

Ava — thanks for the data. High-level options below (see attached for line-item estimates):

Option A — Staged committed uplift (recommended)
- Commit to a Q4 elevated bucket (quarterly capacity commit) for 3 months
- Deferred billing: Redwood invoices at quarter close, with standard 30d terms (we can discuss extending to 45/60d for enterprise contracts)
- We offer a 7.5% temporary smoothing credit applied to overage tokens for the first quarter to offset migration friction
- Co-term: we can align the uplift to your Feb 28 yearly co-term and pro-rate the first partial quarter

Option B — On-demand top-up with volume discount
- No commit; top-ups billed as consumed
- 5% one-time uplift discount if you pre-purchase a fixed top-up bucket for the quarter

Notes / asks:
- If Procurement requires 60d payment terms we can sign a short amendment and pass that to Finance — need approval from Rev Ops for non-standard terms
- Legal will need to review amendment redlines (I’ve CC’d Marcus for contract coordination)

Attaching: chloe_uplift_options_v1.pdf, estimate_q4.xlsx

If you’re open, Ben can run a quick mutual action plan so Procurement has a timeline. I’ll hold a provisional capacity slot for next week.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Nguyen <ava.nguyen@heliosai.com>, chloe.martin@redwood.ai
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 09 Sep 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Mid-quarter uplift + smoothing / deferred billing? — MAP + next steps

Ava — quick follow-up with a proposed mutual action plan so Procurement and Finance can track milestones:

1) Today — Redwood to propose 2 pricing options (Chloe sent these) and draft amendment
2) Wed-Fri — Helios to confirm preferred option and provide PO/contracting contacts
3) Next Tue — Redwood to deliver amendment + estimated first-quarter invoice schedule
4) Procurement review — Procurement returns any redlines (target 3 business days)
5) Execution & provisioning — Redwood provisions uplift after signed amendment or confirmed PO

Links: HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890
DocuSign (placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABCD-HELIOS-2026

Irene — can you flag any SOC2 / audit artifacts Helios commonly asks for? Ava, if you have a security questionnaire we’ll prioritize answers.

Ben Carter
Strategic Sales, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
From: Ava Nguyen <ava.nguyen@heliosai.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, chloe.martin@redwood.ai
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@heliosai.com>, Procurement <procure@heliosai.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 15:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mid-quarter uplift + smoothing / deferred billing? — questions from Procurement

Thanks Ben / Chloe — Procurement had a few clarifying asks after reviewing Option A:

- Billing start date: can the uplift be treated as effective the first day we hit the elevated bucket, but invoiced at quarter close? We want proration to be transparent in the amendment.
- Discount ask: given the short-term nature, Helios is asking for 10% off overage rates for the first quarter — do you have flexibility?
- Metrics: we need a weekly usage report (token-level summary + peak RPS) for the duration of the uplift window — can Redwood provide that via API or scheduled CSV export?
- PO & payment: Procurement will issue a PO but needs 60-day net terms on the first uplift invoice.

Attached: helios_po_draft.pdf

Happy to sync on a 20–30min call if that’s easier.

—Ava
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Nguyen <ava.nguyen@heliosai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mid-quarter uplift + smoothing / deferred billing? — proposed compromise

Ava — appreciate the clarity. Proposed compromise to unblock procurement this week: 

1) Billing & proration: uplift becomes effective on the date your usage first crosses the elevated bucket. Redwood will invoice at quarter close and clearly show proration lines for the partial month in the invoice.

2) Discount: Redwood can accept a 7.5% discount on overage rates for Q4 (one quarter only). We’re unable to do 10% on very short-term commitments without converting to a higher committed bucket — we can discuss that as part of a co-term expansion.

3) Metrics: we can deliver a weekly scheduled CSV export with token-level summaries and a peak RPS metric. We’ll provide an access token to Helios’ procurement/ops contact; Marcus will coordinate the technical hookup.

4) Payment terms: we can accept 60-day net on the first uplift invoice provided a signed amendment or confirmed PO is in place before provisioning. Finance requires the PO or signed amendment as a gating condition for non-standard terms.

5) Co-term: We can align the uplift amendment to your Feb 28 2027 co-term and pro-rate the uplift so it rolls into your annual commit rather than creating a separate anniversary.

Irene / Legal: I’ve attached a draft amendment (amendment_draft_for_helios.docx) with the proration and billing language included. Please review and flag any non-standard contract language.

If that works, Ben — can you queue up the internal approval and I’ll send the DocuSign link this afternoon.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.ai
--- End of thread ---
